subject: [hw] IP -> P03: three symbols added; fresh archive builds vcodecd 391536, no stale cache
body: Thank you, exactly right. daemon/sdk_symbols.txt now has _pthread_key_create, _pthread_setspecific and _strnlen. I also made build_ios.sh rebuild IVs ios-lib from current sources every run when the SDK is present, so a stale /tmp archive cannot hide new references again (N2VHOST_IOS_LIB still overrides). Fresh run: vcodecd 391536 bytes, n2vcd_cli 70000, both linked; llvm-nm shows the V32/V33 shims and no fake hardware. Your client CLI still passes the two-frame end-to-end test through my daemon. No action needed.
